# muse 0.2.1 (0.2.1-R1215.1) absence probes, 2026-08-26:
# 1. `muse --help` + `muse exec --help` searched for memory flags:
#    category flags exist only for write (--disable-write), shell
#    (--disable-shell), web (--disable-web-tools). No memory category.
# 2. ~/.config/muse/settings.json - no memory key; muse config
#    (validate --plane defaults|policy) has no documented memory gate
#    (unverified for the enterprise plane).
# 3. Memory tools exist and persist: tools muse.add_memory /
#    muse.edit_memory; data dir ~/.local/share/muse/memory/projects
#    present on this machine.
# 4. Launcher strings searched (strings ~/.local/bin/muse): no
#    disable-memory / memory_dir spellings.
# Conclusion: no CLI-level or documented config-level off switch for
# memory on muse 0.2.1 - the descriptor's MEMORY GAP comment is the
# watch point; re-probe on every version bump.
